Good afternoon Dusan,

Thanks for checking in. Your order Shop····, the BSB B30 with the Power K., is paid and ships on November 7, going to (address hidden). Nothing has left the warehouse yet, and you will get the tracking number by email the moment the label is printed.

The unit is being built for you in that batch rather than sitting on a shelf, which is why the date is firm rather than immediate. You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Good morning Dusan,

No new date to give you, which in this case is the good news: your B30 and Power K. are still set for November 7, unchanged from what I told you on Monday.

Where it stands right now: your unit is allocated to you at our Chattanooga warehouse and is waiting on the batch that covers your order to be checked in there. Once it lands, your box is packed and the tracking email goes out automatically. Nothing else is needed from you.

On the link, sorry it was not clearer. That page only shows the batches on their way to our warehouses, so it does not list orders individually, and it updates when a shipment moves rather than daily. Your order sits behind the B30 batch shown there.

If anything shifts before November 7, I will write to you here first.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
